lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I need you to talk me out of something. Let's just chat, but here's a little game, the moment I say the word 'cello', jump in and call it out right then. Don't wait for me to finish.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay so I left my coffee on the desk this morning and now it's completely cold. I keep doing this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, that's annoying. How long was it sitting there?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Maybe two hours. I was focused on some work, trying to learn guitar actually, and just forgot about it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Guitar, nice. What are you learning?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Just some basic chords. My neighbour plays drums and he's been showing me stuff too, but guitar feels more my speed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a good way to learn, having someone nearby who plays.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right. I also tried piano once but gave up. Anyway, this morning I was sitting there with my cold coffee thinking, I should really get a thermos. And then I heard my neighbour playing cello through the wall and it was actually kind of beautiful.
